What the numbers mean

Renting software adds up

Each subscription looks small on its own. Together, and multiplied by every user, they often become one of a business's biggest ongoing costs. And because prices are set by vendors, they tend to rise over time.

Per-user pricing also makes growth more expensive: every new hire adds a licence for every app. The "Each new hire adds" figure shows that cost.

EG Eloma builds one custom system that replaces those subscriptions. You own it, including the source code, so there are no per-user licence fees, and any developer can maintain it.

FAQ

Calculator questions

Is the calculator accurate?

It uses the figures you enter. Example figures are shown to start with, so replace them with your own prices and user numbers for a real total.

Why include a yearly price rise?

Software vendors often raise prices over time. You can set the rise to 0% if you'd rather not include it.

Do you store what I enter?

No. Your figures stay in your own browser unless you choose to send them to us by WhatsApp or email.

How much would one owned system cost instead?

Every system is quoted in writing after a free consultation. Send us your results and we'll compare them with a fixed quote, in AUD or USD.

Will one system replace every app?

Usually most of them. If an app is better kept, we'll tell you honestly and connect it to your new system.
